Part_BlackHole_Desc.English: Curved mantis claws launch a gravity field that pulls and damages enemies.
Part_BlackHole_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 弯曲螳爪围出涡心，发射吸引并伤害敌人的引力场。
Part_BlackHole_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 弯曲螳爪圍出渦心，發射吸引并傷害敵人的引力場。
Part_BlackHole_Desc.Russian: Curved mantis claws launch a gravity field that pulls and damages enemies.

Part_Cannon_Desc.English: A swollen sac launches explosive shots that damage an area.
Part_Cannon_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 鼓胀腹囊抛出爆裂弹，造成范围伤害。
Part_Cannon_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 鼓胀腹囊抛出爆裂彈，造成範圍傷害。
Part_Cannon_Desc.Russian: A swollen sac launches explosive shots that damage an area.

Part_EMP_Desc.English: Silk slows unshielded ordinary mobile enemies by 65% for 0.8 seconds without stopping their guns. Control does not stack; bosses and special targets are immune.
Part_EMP_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 丝束命中无护盾的普通移动敌人时减速 65%，持续 0.8 秒，不中断射击。控制不可叠加，首领与特殊目标免疫。
Part_EMP_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 絲束命中無護盾的普通移動敵人時減速 65%，持续 0.8 秒，不中斷射擊。控制不可疊加，首领與特殊目标免疫。
Part_EMP_Desc.Russian: Silk slows unshielded ordinary mobile enemies by 65% for 0.8 seconds without stopping their guns. Control does not stack; bosses and special targets are immune.

Part_FlameThrower_Desc.English: A heated throat continuously breathes flame that bypasses shields.
Part_FlameThrower_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 灼热嗉囊持续喷吐火焰，绕过护盾。
Part_FlameThrower_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 灼熱嗉囊持续噴吐火焰，绕過護盾。
Part_FlameThrower_Desc.Russian: A heated throat continuously breathes flame that bypasses shields.

Part_Gatling_Desc.English: Rapidly fires a stream of small stingers.
Part_Gatling_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 密集尾针连续射击，适合持续压制。
Part_Gatling_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 密集尾針連续射擊，适合持续壓制。
Part_Gatling_Desc.Russian: Rapidly fires a stream of small stingers.

Part_Rocket_Desc.English: Larval pods release a barrage of homing projectiles.
Part_Rocket_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 幼蛹荚连续发射追踪弹。
Part_Rocket_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 幼蛹荚連续發射追蹤彈。
Part_Rocket_Desc.Russian: Larval pods release a barrage of homing projectiles.

Part_Sniper_Desc.English: An elongated proboscis fires a powerful long-range beam.
Part_Sniper_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 细长虫喙发射远距离高伤光束。
Part_Sniper_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 细长蟲喙發射遠距離高傷光束。
Part_Sniper_Desc.Russian: An elongated proboscis fires a powerful long-range beam.

Part_Sonic_Desc.English: Fan-shaped wings emit a wave that damages and pushes enemies away.
Part_Sonic_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 扇形翅膜发出冲击波，伤害并推开敌人。
Part_Sonic_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 扇形翅膜發出冲擊波，傷害并推開敵人。
Part_Sonic_Desc.Russian: Fan-shaped wings emit a wave that damages and pushes enemies away.

Part_Tesla_Desc.English: Tendrils release chained shocks and briefly pull unshielded ordinary mobile enemies toward the firing organ. Pulls do not stack; bosses and special targets are immune.
Part_Tesla_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 触须释放连锁电击，并将无护盾的普通移动敌人短暂拉向发射器官。牵引不可叠加，首领与特殊目标免疫。
Part_Tesla_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 触鬚釋放連鎖電擊，并將無護盾的普通移動敵人短暂拉向發射器官。牵引不可疊加，首领與特殊目标免疫。
Part_Tesla_Desc.Russian: Tendrils release chained shocks and briefly pull unshielded ordinary mobile enemies toward the firing organ. Pulls do not stack; bosses and special targets are immune.

Part_Mines_Desc.English: Places explosive eggs in a circular ring around the segment.
Part_Mines_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 在体节周围布置环形爆卵阵。
Part_Mines_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 在體節周圍布置环形爆卵陣。
Part_Mines_Desc.Russian: Places explosive eggs in a circular ring around the segment.

Part_Fuel_Desc.English: Stores and restores energy used for boosting.
Part_Fuel_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 储存并恢复加速所需能量。
Part_Fuel_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 儲存并恢復加速所需能量。
Part_Fuel_Desc.Russian: Stores and restores energy used for boosting.

Part_Shield_Desc.English: Paired elytra generate a shield around nearby segments.
Part_Shield_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 展开成对鞘翅，为周围体节生成护盾。
Part_Shield_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 展開成對鞘翅，為周圍體節生成護盾。
Part_Shield_Desc.Russian: Paired elytra generate a shield around nearby segments.

Part_Wall_Desc.English: Heavy chitin absorbs damage and protects other segments.
Part_Wall_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 厚重虫鞘承受伤害，保护其他体节。
Part_Wall_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 厚重蟲鞘承受傷害，保護其他體節。
Part_Wall_Desc.Russian: Heavy chitin absorbs damage and protects other segments.

Chip_Chain_Desc.English: Allows projectiles to jump between enemies.
Chip_Chain_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 使弹体在敌人之间跳跃。
Chip_Chain_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 使彈體在敵人之間跳跃。
Chip_Chain_Desc.Russian: Allows projectiles to jump between enemies.

Chip_Exploding_Desc.English: Makes projectiles explode and damage nearby targets.
Chip_Exploding_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 使弹体命中后爆炸，对周围目标造成伤害。
Chip_Exploding_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 使彈體命中后爆炸，對周圍目标造成傷害。
Chip_Exploding_Desc.Russian: Makes projectiles explode and damage nearby targets.

Chip_Mammoth_Desc.English: Increases projectile size, damage and damage area.
Chip_Mammoth_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 增大弹体、伤害及伤害范围。
Chip_Mammoth_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 增大彈體、傷害及傷害範圍。
Chip_Mammoth_Desc.Russian: Increases projectile size, damage and damage area.

Chip_Piercing_Desc.English: Allows projectiles to pierce through enemies.
Chip_Piercing_Desc.Russian: Allows projectiles to pierce through enemies.

Chip_Shrapnel_Desc.English: Causes projectiles to burst into small fragments.
Chip_Shrapnel_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 使弹体爆裂成细小碎刺。
Chip_Shrapnel_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 使彈體爆裂成细小碎刺。
Chip_Shrapnel_Desc.Russian: Causes projectiles to burst into small fragments.

Attack_Drones_Desc.English: Hunter wasps attack the nearest enemy.

Engineer_Drones_Desc.English: Mender ants repair injured body segments.

Scrapper_Drones_Desc.English: Forager ants gather nearby energy crystals.
Scrapper_Drones_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 拾蚁收集附近的能量水晶。
Scrapper_Drones_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 拾蟻收集附近的能量水晶。

Reward_Boost_Desc.English: Improves boost speed and energy efficiency.
Reward_Boost_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 提高加速速度与能量利用效率。
Reward_Boost_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 提高加速速度與能量利用效率。
Reward_Boost_Desc.Russian: Повышает скорость рывка и эффективность расхода энергии.

Reward_Switch_Desc.English: Allows to switch between two parts
Reward_Switch_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 允许在两个部件之间切换
Reward_Switch_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 允許在兩個部件之間切換

Tip_1.English: Patrolling insects will not chase you over long distances.
Tip_1.Chinese (simplified): 巡逻虫不会长距离追击你。
Tip_1.Chinese (traditional): 巡逻蟲不會长距離追擊你。
Tip_1.Russian: Патрульные насекомые не преследуют вас на больших расстояниях.

Tip_2.English: Stay clear of patrol routes and leave room to turn.
Tip_2.Chinese (simplified): 避开巡逻虫的路线，为身体留出转向空间。
Tip_2.Chinese (traditional): 避開巡逻蟲的路线，為身體留出轉向空間。
Tip_2.Russian: Избегайте маршрутов патруля и оставляйте место для поворота.

Tip_3.English: An organ upgrade improves all of its listed attributes.
Tip_3.Chinese (simplified): 攻击器官升级会提升列出的各项属性。
Tip_3.Chinese (traditional): 攻擊器官升級會提升列出的各项屬性。
Tip_3.Russian: Улучшение органа повышает все перечисленные характеристики.

Tip_4.English: Shields will recharge to half their health after being depleted
Tip_4.Chinese (simplified): 护盾耗尽后会恢复一半生命值
Tip_4.Chinese (traditional): 護盾耗盡後會恢復一半生命值
Tip_4.Russian: Щиты будут восстанавливаться до половины здоровья после истощения

Tip_5.English: The nectar sac shows the energy available for boosting.
Tip_5.Chinese (simplified): 蜜囊显示剩余能量；有能量才能加速。
Tip_5.Chinese (traditional): 蜜囊显示剩餘能量；有能量才能加速。
Tip_5.Russian: Нектарный мешок показывает запас энергии для рывка.

Tip_6.English: EMP will turn off the shields completely
Tip_6.Chinese (simplified): 电磁脉冲会完全关闭防护罩
Tip_6.Chinese (traditional): 電磁脈衝會完全關閉防護罩

Tip_7.English: A boss's attack organs resist electrical disruption.
Tip_7.Chinese (simplified): 首领的攻击器官不会被电脉冲瘫痪。
Tip_7.Chinese (traditional): 首领的攻擊器官不會被電脉冲瘫痪。
Tip_7.Russian: Атакующие органы босса устойчивы к электрическому подавлению.

Tip_8.English: The flamethrower can damage through the shields
Tip_8.Chinese (simplified): 火焰喷射器可以破坏防护罩
Tip_8.Chinese (traditional): 火焰噴射器可以破壞防護罩
Tip_8.Russian: Огнемет может нанести урон через щиты

Tip_9.English: An attack organ can benefit from several support organs.
Tip_9.Chinese (simplified): 一个攻击器官可同时受到多个支援器官强化。
Tip_9.Chinese (traditional): 一個攻擊器官可同時受到多個支援器官強化。
Tip_9.Russian: Атакующий орган может получать усиления от нескольких вспомогательных органов.

Tip_10.English: Repeated support organs can stack their effects.
Tip_10.Chinese (simplified): 同类支援器官的强化效果可以叠加。
Tip_10.Chinese (traditional): 同类支援器官的強化效果可以疊加。

Tip_11.English: Protect the body with chitin when shields are depleted.
Tip_11.Chinese (simplified): 护盾失效时，用甲壳保护身体和攻击器官。
Tip_11.Chinese (traditional): 護盾失效時，用甲壳保護身體和攻擊器官。
Tip_11.Russian: Когда щиты истощены, защищайте тело хитином.

Tip_12.English: The final Boss speed will increase over time
Tip_12.Chinese (simplified): 最终Boss的速度会随着时间慢慢提高
Tip_12.Chinese (traditional): 最終Boss的速度會隨著時間慢慢提高
Tip_12.Russian: Скорость финального босса будет увеличиваться с течением времени

Tip_13.English: Mining ore yields energy crystals; nests yield mutation supplies.
Tip_13.Chinese (simplified): 开采矿脉获得能量水晶，击破虫巢获得进化补给。
Tip_13.Chinese (traditional): 開采矿脉獲得能量水晶，擊破蟲巢獲得進化補給。
Tip_13.Russian: Добыча руды даёт кристаллы энергии, разрушение гнёзд — припасы для мутации.

Tip_14.English: The packs color indicates its rarity
Tip_14.Chinese (simplified): 包装的颜色表明其稀有度
Tip_14.Chinese (traditional): 包裝的顏色表明其稀有度
Tip_14.Russian: Цвет упаковки указывает на ее редкость

Tip_15.English: Enemies can’t rotate when they dash
Tip_15.Chinese (simplified): 敌人在冲刺时不能旋转
Tip_15.Chinese (traditional): 敵人在衝刺時不能旋轉
Tip_15.Russian: Враги не могут вращаться, когда они бросаются.

Tip_16.English: Brood nests keep spawning reinforcements. Destroy them early.
Tip_16.Chinese (simplified): 孵化虫巢会持续产生增援，尽早将其摧毁。
Tip_16.Chinese (traditional): 孵化蟲巢會持续產生增援，盡早將其摧毀。
Tip_16.Russian: Гнёзда выводка постоянно порождают подкрепления. Уничтожайте их первыми.

Tip_17.English: Some enemies will try to escape when they're about to die, don’t let them
Tip_17.Chinese (simplified): 有些敌人会在快死的时候逃跑，别让他们得逞
Tip_17.Chinese (traditional): 有些敵人會在快死的時候逃跑，別讓他們得逞
Tip_17.Russian: Некоторые враги будут пытаться убежать, когда они вот-вот умрут, не позволяйте им этого.

Tip_18.English: Support organs affect adjacent modules; shields cover a radius.
Tip_18.Chinese (simplified): 支援器官强化相邻模块，护盾按范围覆盖。
Tip_18.Chinese (traditional): 支援器官強化相鄰模块，護盾按範圍覆盖。
Tip_18.Russian: Вспомогательные органы усиливают соседние модули; щиты действуют в радиусе.

Play_Endless_Desc.English: Survive for as long as you can

Play_Mission_Running_Desc.English: Eliminate the fleeing brood before it escapes.
Play_Mission_Running_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 在逃窜虫群离开前将其消灭。
Play_Mission_Running_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 在逃窜蟲群離開前將其消灭。
Play_Mission_Running_Desc.Russian: Уничтожьте убегающий выводок, прежде чем он скроется.

Play_Mission_Station_Desc.English: Destroy the enemy nest before reinforcements arrive.
Play_Mission_Station_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 在增援到来前摧毁敌方虫巢。
Play_Mission_Station_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 在增援到來前摧毀敵方蟲巢。
Play_Mission_Station_Desc.Russian: Уничтожьте вражеское гнездо до прибытия подкрепления.

Play_Mission_Protect_Desc.English: Lead the migrating brood to safety.
Play_Mission_Protect_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 护送迁徙虫群抵达安全区。
Play_Mission_Protect_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 護送遷徙蟲群抵达安全區。
Play_Mission_Protect_Desc.Russian: Проведите переселяющийся выводок в безопасную зону.

Play_Mission_ProtectStation_Desc.English: Defend the nest from waves of enemies.
Play_Mission_ProtectStation_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 抵御一波波敌人，保护己方虫巢。
Play_Mission_ProtectStation_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 抵御一波波敵人，保護己方蟲巢。

Part_Clock_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 遮蔽周围体节，使其不被敌人发现。
Part_Clock_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 遮蔽周圍體節，使其不被敵人發现。

Part_Flak_Desc.English: A radial thorn crown fires clusters across multiple targets.
Part_Flak_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 放射刺冠发射密集弹簇，覆盖多个目标。
Part_Flak_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 放射刺冠發射密集彈簇，覆盖多個目标。
Part_Flak_Desc.Russian: A radial thorn crown fires clusters across multiple targets.

Part_Shotgun_Desc.English: Open mandibles release a fan of pellets.
Part_Shotgun_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 张开的虫颚一次喷出扇形弹群。
Part_Shotgun_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 张開的蟲顎一次噴出扇形彈群。
Part_Shotgun_Desc.Russian: Open mandibles release a fan of pellets.

Part_Nuke_Desc.English: A thick queen egg releases a heavy projectile with high area damage.
Part_Nuke_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 厚壳王卵释放重型爆裂弹，造成大范围高伤害。
Part_Nuke_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 厚壳王卵釋放重型爆裂彈，造成大範圍高傷害。
Part_Nuke_Desc.Russian: A thick queen egg releases a heavy projectile with high area damage.

Part_MinesSpawner_Desc.English: While moving, releases a circular ring of explosive eggs that remain behind for enemies to trigger.
Part_MinesSpawner_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 移动时向体节周围释放一圈爆卵，留在原地等待敌人触发。
Part_MinesSpawner_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 移動時向體節周圍釋放一圈爆卵，留在原地等待敵人触發。
Part_MinesSpawner_Desc.Russian: While moving, releases a circular ring of explosive eggs that remain behind for enemies to trigger.

Part_Repair_Desc.English: A symbiotic organ repairs surrounding damaged segments.
Part_Repair_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 共生虫器持续修复周围受损体节。
Part_Repair_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 共生蟲器持续修復周圍受損體節。
Part_Repair_Desc.Russian: A symbiotic organ repairs surrounding damaged segments.

Chip_HQ_Desc.English: Allows manual aiming for weapons on adjacent segments.
Chip_HQ_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 允许手动瞄准前后相邻体节上的武装。
Chip_HQ_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 允许手動瞄准前后相鄰體節上的武裝。
Chip_HQ_Desc.Russian: Allows manual aiming for weapons on adjacent segments.

Reward_Move_Desc.English: Repositions a module on the body.
Reward_Move_Desc.Chinese (simplified): 调整身体上模块的位置。
Reward_Move_Desc.Chinese (traditional): 调整身體上模块的位置。

Reward_WallCores_Desc.English: Adds protective chitin to a body segment.

Leaderboard_Note.English: *All scores are set in the Hard Difficulty
Leaderboard_Note.Chinese (simplified): *所有分数均在困难难度中设置
Leaderboard_Note.Chinese (traditional): *所有分數均在困難難度中設置
